I never received the product ordered from Wellfittreadmill. This review is strictly regarding the company’s customer support services. I ordered a home treadmill from Wellfittreadmill through Facebook. They delivered the treadmill through FedEx. On the day I was expecting the delivery, I got the notification that FedEx delivered my package at my front door. I opened my door, and there was no package. I immediately called FedEx support and notified them that the package wasn’t delivered to my door. Immediately after, I notified Wellfittreadmill and informed them of what happened. Initially, I thought someone stole my package, but I was home when I got the notification. The package was too big for someone to have come up my stairs and left with it without me seeing them. It was a long process but I eventually obtained proof that FedEx misdelivered my package through their GPS ping system. FedEx had it documented that the driver delivered the package to my door, but their GPS ping system showed the package was delivered at a different building. Customer support from Wellfittreadmill also suggested I ask about our cameras within the community. I did just as they suggested and obtained proof from my HOA, who viewed the footage, that the FedEx driver did deliver 2 packages around the time I reported, but never approached my building. To seal the deal, I was able to obtain an email confirmation from FedEx that they misdelivered my package and that the shipper needed to contact them to file a claim. Upon Wellfittreadmill receiving all the proof that my package was delivered to the wrong location, they still maintained they had not received any information from FedEx, that they only have the documentation that FedEx delivered my package, and that if it was lost or stolen, per their policy I would have to file a claim through FedEx. FedEx has always stated the shipper needed to be the one to file the claim. I got FedEx to send me the misdelivery confirmation email for proof. I purchased the product through Klarna and sent them ALL the proof that I sent Wellfittreadmill. If it weren’t for Klarna ruling in my favor and returning the funds, I would still be liable for paying for a product I never received. FedEx and Klarna were more helpful and sympathetic than the company I ordered the product from. FedEx informed me they never heard from the shipper (Wellfittreadmill), and it makes sense because it was clear they were not trying to help me. I will never order anything from this company ever again. I saw after the fact that they had postal protection coverage. Somehow I missed that, and I highly recommend getting that if you’re going to purchase from this company. Hopefully, if you do they won’t try to find loopholes around that!

I was told on ordering that my treadmill would be delivered by Yodel, Evri or Fed Ex, so I was looking out in my emails for communication from them. None arrived!

I was away from home when I received a random text from a company called XDP about delivery of my consignment. After checking the order number I found it to be my treadmill. I signed digitally for the item and sent the QR code they sent me to my mother as I was told this had to be scanned at delivery.

At this point I also realised I had some emails from them in my spam box. I had not read them as I had no idea who they were, I was not expecting anything to be delivered through them, and there are often similar emails which are scams.

I rushed home to find my elderly disabled mother on the bottom floor of our flats, in floods of tears. She had answered the intercom and expected the item to be brought upstairs. Instead, the driver buzzed again and said it was on the ground floor.she said she was very elderly and asked how she would get it up two flights of stairs. There was no response, he just left, having partially blocked the entrance doorway.My mother had tried a few neighbours for help, but being holiday season, many are away.

By luck, my neighbour's son arrived to visit and helped me upstairs, though being a pensioner myself I was of little help and have suffered considerable bruising.

When I ordered they said delivery by Fed Ex, Evri or Yodel, and there was no mention that they would not deliver to the house. However, after putting in a complaint to them,they have changed the info on the website! Luckily I had photographed the info on the site at the time of ordering so still have that! However, this left an elderly,disabled lady in a terribly upsetting position. Had this information been given to me I would NEVER have ordered from them. They did not even do me the courtesy of responding to me!

Before ordering with them, please ask them for the most up to date delivery info.
